stem.en: One living cell from a mature leaf is given suitable nutrients and favourable conditions, and it develops into a complete plant. Which ability of plant cells does this show?

feedback.en: This stops division when cells touch, and plant cells do not show it.
This describes what crosses a membrane.
This removes cells. Here a whole plant forms from one cell.
Yes. One plant cell can form all the types of cell in a plant.

explanation.en: Totipotency is the ability of a plant cell to form different types of cells and to change them, so that one cell can give a complete plant.
